fo20_reverse20_query_budget_audit.explanation: Both conditions made exactly one policy query per executed environment step in every block. Realized query totals differ only because trajectories and success termination produce different episode lengths.
fo20_reverse20_query_budget_audit.early_termination_effect: Yes. Success termination shortens an episode and therefore reduces both environment steps and queries for that condition, changing aggregate totals but not the one-query-per-executed-step rate.

coherent_horizon_assessment.wording: Across the evaluated ACT cohorts, H8, H13, and H16 form a competitive moderate-horizon band; point-estimate ordering changes by cohort, and no unique optimum reproduces.

smolvla_absolute_performance_context.paper_sentence: Our SmolVLA absolute rates differ from the larger standard evaluation in both directions across suites; our componentwise conclusions use only within-protocol paired comparisons and never subtract against those external aggregate rates.
